I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread to confirm his correction: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats. As he asked, I took no other action. I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team next to his original message so the team sees it.

I didn't look up or repeat the figure he posted earlier in #central-team. The seat count is an account detail, not a money figure, so posting it in that thread didn't need anyone's approval.
